environment.resolution_policy: sys.path order; repeated names in different locations are shadowed, not active duplicates

profile.name: fixed_max_segments_batch
profile.cache: fresh per-run vector DB, pinned local encoder snapshot
profile.order: all 462 JSONL rows, no shuffle or pointer remapping

action_contract.legacy_without_v14_policy: Preserved legacy branch; never selected implicitly for a V14 model
action_contract.serving_final_answer: policy accepted AND independent exact execution/certificate/presentation success
action_contract.failed_presentation_status: UNKNOWN for unavailable execution/certificate details, INVALID for known failure; never claim VALID
action_contract.multi_output: New final_action ANSWER/PARTIAL/ABSTAIN/REJECT; legacy transport status/coverage retained with verified outputs

coordinate_contract.migration: Exact line/substr replay; all old fields and pointers unchanged

role_contract: Unspecified role may participate in logical identity only with validated versioned coordinates and no required/conflicting role. No ACTUAL inferred.

validation.source_stage_reports: Gate replays on saved proposals; not new neural inference
validation.new_proof_wrong: Review and HOLD promotion if found
